goal: Define the Phase 4A production system retrospective execution unit so Phase 0-3 evidence can be synthesized into a Phase 4B Complex Prototype Production Validation handoff.

verify.name: Phase 4A retrospective artifact path is defined
verify.description: Confirm the retrospective target path is production_retrospectives/PR-2026W22-001-phase4a-production-system-retrospective-KR.md and the artifact scope is evidence synthesis only.

verify.name: Phase 4B handoff plan path is defined
verify.description: Confirm the handoff plan target path is plans/PHASE4B_COMPLEX_PROTOTYPE_VALIDATION_PLAN.md and it must define complex prototype validation criteria rather than final game scope.

verify.name: Phase 0-3 evidence coverage is required
verify.description: Confirm the future retrospective must cite each closeout document at least once and must separate Phase 0-3 evidence from assumptions.

verify.name: Decision matrices are required
verify.description: Confirm role handoff, QA gates, Learning Card triage, automation candidates, and repo hygiene decisions each use keep, revise, defer, or remove.

verify.name: Phase 4B readiness criteria are required
verify.description: Confirm the plan must define minimum complexity, role sequence, QA gates, owner decision points, and stop conditions before any Phase 4B Godot implementation Work Package can be written.

human_decision_reason: Human Creative Owner must approve the Phase 4B complex prototype validation scope before any production implementation starts.
acceptance_criteria: The Phase 4A retrospective scope is limited to Phase 0-3 evidence synthesis and production-system decisions.
The Phase 4B handoff plan defines a prototype that is more complex than the Phase 2 greybox and Phase 3 art import validation.

The Phase 4B minimum complexity criteria require at least three concrete complexity features such as multi-section flow, enemy or hazard, progression state, camera behavior, richer UI state, animation, imported gameplay-readable art, or player-facing feel gates.
Role boundary, QA gate, Learning Card triage, automation, and repo hygiene decisions are separated into explicit keep, revise, defer, or remove outcomes.
Learning Card promotion candidates may be identified, but no Working, Canonical, or Policy promotion is executed.
No Godot files, gameplay systems, art assets, external tester workflow, platform launch feedback, Work Package lifecycle moves, or git operations are changed by this planning slice.
notes: Phase 4 must not close as a simple retrospective. This Work Package exists to make Phase 4A produce the decision surface needed for Phase 4B Complex Prototype Production Validation.
